readme:
Turn anything you want to understand, plan, or share into an interactive visual.

Official channels： archify.si · GitHub
Archify is free and open source. Third-party online services and paid plans are operated by their respective providers and do not represent Archify. Service details →

Start with an idea, a question, or a plan. Describe it to your AI agent, and Archify turns it into an interactive HTML you can explore, customize, and share. From travel itineraries and learning maps to complex systems—make it your own.

See what the community is creating—and imagine what you could make next.

Live demos  ·  Get started  ·  Scenario guide  ·  Community  ·  简体中文  ·  日本語  ·  한국어

❤️ Partners & sponsors: Kimi Work · Supercode · OpenLux

## See Archify in action https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/78570807-ba1d-4737-953f-55504a378a87 **One sentence. Your repo, mapped.** Watch the 35-second demo: explore the diagram, follow source links, and trace a path. [Try the interactive examples ↗](https://archify.si/gallery.html) ### Install, then describe your idea Works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode. See installation options below for additional integrations. **With an AI agent.** Paste this: ```text Install Archify for me by reading https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tt-a1i/archify/main/llms.txt ``` Send this to your agent: ```text Use Archify to diagram a web request: Browser calls the API, the API checks Redis, and a cache miss queries PostgreSQL and fills the cache. ``` Then continue: “Add authentication”, “Highlight the cache-miss path”, or “Switch to the light theme”. **No repository is required:** start with a description, or ask your agent to read a repository for a source-backed architecture diagram. [Choose your agent](https://archify.si/start.html?agent=cursor&type=architecture) · [Installation details and update checks](#quick-start) · [Create and check diagrams with your agent](https://archify.si/agent-diagrams) ## Ask a question, get a one-page answer Not every answer is one diagram. Ask your agent to answer as a page and Archify builds an **explainer**: the conclusion first, then one panel per question, with tables, steps, charts, code and validated diagrams. [![An explainer page: the answer first, then steps beside the sequence diagram they walk through](docs/assets/explainer-tls-en.png)](https://archify.si/cases/explainer/tls-first-visit.html) - **Conclusion first.** The answer and its reasons lead; every panel takes one question. - **Diagrams that explain.** Steps sit beside the diagram they walk through and light its parts as you read. Click any node to open the full interactive view. - **Easy to check.** Claims cite numbered sources; repository excerpts are pinned to a commit and open in a source card. - **Easy to share.** One HTML file with four styles and light or dark themes. Export a PNG, WebP or JPG long image, or print to PDF. Ask about any panel to get a follow-up your agent can use to revise just that panel. ```text Use Archify to answer as one page: our API's P99 went from 80 ms to 600 ms while the mean barely moved. What is the likely cause, and how should we investigate? ``` By default your agent also makes a page unasked when an answer is a complex flow, a diagnosis, a comparison or a test report. The reply still gives a short conclusion you can read in chat, and its last line links to the page, such as “Open the test report”. Short answers, text-only requests and failed pages get no page or link. To get pages only when you ask, tell your agent so, or add `[archify explainer: on-demand]` to its global rules file (such as `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` or `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`). `[archify explainer: always-on]` adds a compact page to every answer that reaches a conclusion; deleting the line restores the default. Live examples: [First HTTPS visit](https://archify.si/cases/explainer/tls-first-visit.html) · [P99 latency (Chinese)](https://archify.si/cases/explainer/p99-tail-latency.html) · [How Archify finalize keeps the last good file, read from this repository (Chinese)](https://archify.si/cases/explainer/finalize-delivery.html) · [First rental checklist (Chinese)](https://archify.si/cases/explainer/first-rental.html) ## ❤️ Sponsors

Built into the Skill, no extra install | Dependency star map | 3D model of the same run | |---|---| | [![Atlas star map: modules around a ring, file dependencies drawn across it, findings and coupling in the side panel](docs/assets/code-analysis-views/atlas.png)](archify/modules/code-analysis/docs/USAGE.md) | [![Atlas 3D: the most-depended-on module as the trunk, other modules branching at the height of their dependency layer](docs/assets/code-analysis-views/atlas-3d.png)](archify/modules/code-analysis/docs/USAGE.md) | **Architecture Diagnosis** reads a repository and shows how it actually hangs together: dependency cycles, tightly coupled modules, complexity hotspots and layer-rule breaks, each linked to the source behind it, with a fix task you can hand back to your agent. Pair it with an architecture diagram and every component shows its issue count. JS/TS, Python, Java, Go, Rust, C and C++ are supported; the result is one offline HTML file. ```text Use archify Code Analysis on this repository: show module coupling, dependency cycles and hotspots. ``` [Code Analysis guide](archify/modules/code-analysis/docs/USAGE.md) ### Walk through it as a story, or a pull request STORY · PR WALKTHROUGH - **Story video.** Ask your agent to add a guided story to any diagram. The page gains a Story mode with a timeline and captions, and **Export → Story video** records it at 1080p, 60 fps (WebM or MP4). Several diagrams can also be choreographed into one stage page or video. [Story authoring](archify/references/story-authoring.md) - **PR walkthrough.** Ask your agent to explain a pull request or branch: Archify marks what changed directly on the diagram and can attach light and dark diagrams to a GitHub PR or GitLab MR. The optional `archify-pr` Skill offers this while you prepare a PR, and only for material diffs. [PR review](archify/references/pr-review.md) ```text Use archify to add a guided story to this diagram and export it as a video. ``` ### Easy to extend. More ways to make it yours. COMMUNITY STORIES · Selected examples shared by users **Keep building after the diagram is generated.** Archify is open source and its output is standalone HTML. Ask your agent to adapt it, connect useful links, or add interactions for your own workflow. Community creations already span team collaboration, travel planning, legal citation checks, contract review, and incident retrospectives. These are just a few examples. One user started with a hand-drawn multi-agent architecture, turned it into an interactive diagram, then added a Kimi execution pool through conversation. Others asked their agent to read a project and brought the resulting architecture into Feishu or DingTalk for team discussion. Another user turned a Shanghai CityWalk guide into a four-day itinerary: switch between days, inspect a stop, and jump to Amap, Xiaohongshu, or Dianping. The author also added arrival check-ins and stop notes, turning the itinerary into a small tool to use during the trip.
